# Report format

> Generated by `tools/` from the inputs in `source/`. Every statement below is backed by assembly metadata, IL, or a supplied export sample.
> Anything that could not be proven from those inputs is marked **Unknown** rather than guessed.

**Source table:** `met_Report` · **Confidence:** Verified

`ReportData` is an opaque blob. The Stimulsoft assemblies in `source/` make an `.mrt` payload plausible, but no sample was decoded to confirm it, so the blob's contents are **Unknown**.

| Column | XSD type | Nullable in schema | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | string | yes | Report name. |
| `SearchObjectId` | long | yes | Object the report searches over. |
| `Descrioption` | string | yes | Description. Misspelling is Barsa's, preserved here. |
| `SecurityDescriptor` | string | yes | Access control payload — contents Unknown. |
| `AccessLevel` | int | yes |  |
| `ReportData` | base64Binary | yes | Opaque blob — contents Unknown. |
| `activityDefId` | long | yes |  |
| `reportType` | long | yes | Discriminator — value set Unknown. |
| `iconName` | string | yes |  |
| `iconImage` | base64Binary | yes |  |
| `systemId` | long | yes | Owning MET_METASYSTEM row. |
| `scopeType` | int | yes |  |
| `isInsideView` | boolean | yes |  |
| `ID` | long | yes | Primary key. |

Column meanings left blank are **Unknown**: the column name alone is not
evidence of its semantics.
